The recruitment at a glance

Advt. 04/2026Advt. 08/2025
PostsGroup D (Sevadar, Chowkidar) - number depends on the demands departments send by 30 September 2026331 posts
Applications27 February to 20 March 2026 (fee by the same date)21 November to 15 December 2025
PayRs 18,000-56,900 (Level 1, 7th CPC)Rs 18,000-56,900 (Level 1, 7th CPC)
Age counted on1 January 20261 January 2025

Under Advt. 04/2026, PSSSB makes one common merit list and fills Group D vacancies that departments send until 30 September 2026. Demands received after that date are not filled from this list.

The 331 posts of Advt. 08/2025 were:

PostPosts
Sevadar216 (General Administration 150, Dairy Development 22, DC Mansa 18, Chief Auditor Cooperative Societies 15, Fisheries 11)
Machhi Palak (Fisherman)68
Chowkidar27 (General Administration 22, Fisheries 5)
Sweeper-cum-Chowkidar10 (Dairy 4, Fisheries 6)
Safai Sewak5
Mali-cum-Chowkidar2
Sweeper-cum-Mali, Boatman, Laboratory Attendant1 each

Fee

CategoryFee
General, freedom fighter, sportsRs 1,000
SC / BC / EWSRs 250
Ex-servicemen and dependentsRs 200
Persons with disabilitiesRs 500

The fee is not refunded. Reservation is only for residents of Punjab, with a domicile certificate not older than 5 years at counselling.
